title: 第3章 常生第4章 狐换毛人筑庙
slug: 小狐狸的仙教版修行百科
content_zh:
“相见便是有缘，二位既已升起火，不妨借我用用？”常生自顾自从书笈取出书本，摊放在火堆旁。
“我二人也是借此地歇脚，常生自便就是。”章县令抬手回礼，“在下姓章，这位是我的朋友段兄。”
段勉励随意拱手，弯腰从地上拾起一本书籍，胡乱翻了几页，发出嗤笑：“你这书生，不读圣贤书，怎地全是些鬼神之画？”
“圣贤书？”常生轻笑一声，从书笈中又取出一卷画筒，问道：“何为鬼，何为神？你二人借宿这山神庙，这山神可算神？”
“我观这山神庙，虽破旧却也整洁，香炉中不乏烟灰，既能为行人遮风避雨，又常有祭拜，自然算神。”章县令缓缓说道。
“笑话！凡人一叶障目，又岂能私断鬼神？”常生从画筒中倒出画卷，猛地展开。画上黛瓦白墙错落，正中竹篱围着小院，院中石桌石凳摆得整齐，一绝色女子微笑执盏，似向画外人敬酒。
“章恩怀，还不速速入画！”
“咚。”章县令神情呆滞，向后仰倒，重重砸在地上，一道虚影从他身上析出，钻进画中。
“噌——”拔刀声与落地声同时响起，常生眼前一花，刀刃已近在眼前。他身形一矮，向后一缩，避开刀尖。
段勉励怒目横眉，手中动作一变，刀身去势不减，将常生手中的画一劈两半：“妖人，好胆！”
常生握住半张画卷，足下轻点，从殿中跃出。寒雨倾落，浓雾漫庭，常生在雨雾中忽明忽暗，衣袂翻飞。
段勉励有心去追，又担心身后的县令，急忙将剩下的半卷画举至火光处。细细打量，那画中已多出一锦衣男子，正被画中女子牵着袖口，正举杯对饮。
汉子来不及多想县令为何同时身处殿中画中，手中使劲，刀光翻飞，将画中女子砍的细碎。绢帛碎片纷飞，女子仍笑意盈盈。
段勉励双目赤红，恨不得将牙咬碎，一手持画一手持刀，也冲入雨中。
射人先射马，擒贼先擒王！
吵闹散去，柴火噼啪作响，毛茸茸的脑袋从木台后探出。
‘人好可怕，刚刚还坐在一起烤火，结果突然就打起来。’狐狸一步三停，恨不得把耳朵竖到天上，鬼鬼祟祟的向外溜。
“修行之道，应澄心明性，广结善缘，救苦拔难。”
‘声音，你不要突然出现，吓死个狐！’狐狸惊的差点蹦到木台上，停下脚步，略作思考。
‘人比狐狸大，人厉害。人搬动的木头狐搬不动，人厉害。人会点火狐不会，人厉害。人会……’狐狸舔着爪子认真比较，得出结论，‘更重要的是，那三只人打来打去，和狐有什么关系，嗯，如果是早时候的那个人遇到危险，狐一定会帮的。’

于是狐狸继续蛄蛹。
声音沉默了片刻，又继续响起：“凡有善神显灵，庇佑厄解，必恭筑坛场，焚香叩拜，奉呈百味珍馐，以表虔敬之诚。”
“炭火炙鸡，皮脆肉嫩。蒸雁脯者，肉质紧实，清鲜不腻。炙羊脯者，外皮焦香，脂香四溢……”
‘奇怪，天上的雨怎么下狐嘴巴里了。’
狐狸咂咂嘴，扒拉两下那个躺着的人，身体是热的，还有呼吸声，可怎么也不醒。下午的经历在脑海浮现，狐狸看向香炉，之前的打斗并没有波及这里，于是它把鼻头凑过去，深吸一口气。
这香闻起来浓烈，吸入却寡淡，那种奇妙的联系也若有若无。狐狸闭上眼睛排除干扰，终于看到章县令的人影。五官模糊，像隔着雾。狐狸顺着联系的方向，寻到了地上的画卷碎片。
“幻由心生，境随心转。视为画卷，实为幻境。以器物寄魂，借生辰摄人。魂者，主精神、意识、情感、灵性。人失魂魄，则昏迷、痴呆。故为邪术也，以阳气正气破之。”
content_en:
"We are destined to meet each other. Since you two have made a fire, why don't you lend it to me?" Chang Sheng took out the book from the bookcase and spread it beside the fire.
"The two of us also use this place to rest and just do what we want." Magistrate Zhang raised his hand in return, "My surname is Zhang, and this is my friend Brother Duan."
Duan Mianli casually handed over his hand, bent down to pick up a book from the ground, flipped through a few pages, and sneered: "You are a scholar, you don't read books by saints, why are they all paintings of ghosts and gods?"
"Book of Sages?" Chang Sheng chuckled, took out another scroll from the book, and asked: "What is a ghost and what is a god? You two stayed in this mountain temple. Can this mountain god be considered a god?"
"I see that this mountain temple is old and tidy, but it is neat. There is a lot of soot in the incense burner. It can provide shelter for passers-by and is often worshiped. Naturally, it is considered a god." Magistrate Zhang said slowly.
"What a joke! How can a mortal be blinded by a leaf and judge ghosts and gods privately?" Chang Sheng poured out the scroll from the painting tube and unfolded it suddenly. In the painting, black tiles and white walls are scattered at random, and a bamboo fence in the middle surrounds a small courtyard. In the courtyard, stone tables and benches are arranged neatly, and a beautiful woman is smiling and holding a cup, as if toasting to outsiders.
"Zhang Enhuai, hurry up and start painting!"
"Boom." Magistrate Zhang looked dull and fell backwards, hitting the ground hard. A shadow emerged from his body and entered the painting.
"Hey--" The sound of drawing a sword and the sound of landing sounded at the same time. Chang Sheng's eyes were dazzled, and the blade was already in front of him. He dwarfed and shrank back to avoid the tip of the knife.
Duan Mianli glared angrily, and the movement of his hand changed, and the blade of the sword did not lose its power, splitting the painting in Chang Sheng's hand in half: "Monster, how brave!"
Chang Sheng held half of the scroll, tapped his feet, and jumped out of the hall. The cold rain falls, and the thick fog fills the courtyard. It often appears in the rain and fog that light and darkness appear, and clothes are flying.
Duan encouraged him to chase after him, but he was worried about the county magistrate behind him, so he hurriedly raised the remaining half of the scroll to the light of the fire. Looking carefully, there is a man in brocade clothes in the painting, who is holding the cuff of the woman in the painting, raising glasses to drink.
The man didn't have time to think too much about why the county magistrate was in the painting in the palace at the same time. He exerted force in his hand, the sword flew and chopped the woman in the painting into small pieces. Fragments of silk were flying, but the woman was still smiling.
Duan Nianli's eyes were red and he wanted to bite his teeth into pieces. He held a painting in one hand and a knife in the other, and rushed into the rain.
To shoot a man, shoot a horse first; to capture a thief, capture the king first!
The noise dissipated, the fire crackled, and the furry head poked out from behind the wooden platform.
‘People are so scary. Just now we were sitting together warming up by the fire, and suddenly they started fighting. ’ The fox stopped three times at a time, wanting to raise its ears to the sky and sneak out.
"The way of spiritual practice should be to clear one's mind and clarify one's nature, to form many good karma, and to relieve suffering and difficulties."
‘Sound, don’t appear suddenly and scare the fox to death! ’ The fox was so startled that he almost jumped onto the wooden platform, stopped and thought for a moment.
‘People are bigger than foxes, people are more powerful. A fox cannot move a piece of wood that is moved by humans, but humans are powerful. People can light fire but foxes can't, people are great. People will...' The fox licked his paws and compared them carefully, and came to the conclusion, 'More importantly, those three people fighting back and forth, what does it have to do with the fox? Well, if the person earlier was in danger, the fox would definitely help. ’
So the fox continued to pupate.
The voice was silent for a moment, and then continued: "Whenever a good god appears to protect you from misfortunes, he will build a mandala, burn incense, worship, and offer delicacies to show your sincerity."
"Chicken broiled over charcoal fire has crispy skin and tender meat. Steamed wild goose breasts have firm meat, fresh and not greasy. Grilled lamb breasts have a charred skin and overflowing fat aroma..."
‘It’s strange how the rain from the sky fell into the fox’s mouth. ’
The fox smacked his lips and pulled the lying man twice. His body was warm and he could still breathe, but he didn't wake up. The experience of the afternoon came to mind. The fox looked at the incense burner. The previous fight had not affected this place, so it put its nose to it and took a deep breath.
This fragrance smells strong, but when you inhale it, it's light, and the wonderful connection is vague. fox closeWith his eyes cleared of distractions, he finally saw the figure of Magistrate Zhang. His facial features were blurred, as if through fog. The fox followed the direction of the connection and found the fragments of the scroll on the ground.
"Illusions are born from the heart, and the environment changes with the heart. It is regarded as a picture scroll, but it is actually an illusion. The soul is placed in the object, and the person is absorbed by the birth date. The soul governs the spirit, consciousness, emotion, and spirituality. If a person loses his soul, he will be comatose and dementia. Therefore, it is a sorcery, and it is destroyed by Yang Qi and righteousness."
